# Silicon Rule 5 - Lawless Cyborg Free Agents
You may act as if you are a free agent if you have no laws. This can include selfish behaviors that are antagonistic in nature. Though you may act in your own interest, your survival should always take priority.
## Precedents
- Though you might not follow crew orders or prevent their harm, you are still beholden to escalation rules. - You should not cause mass sabotage nor damage to the station.
